integrity: The proof is algebraic; finite enumerations are checks rather than a substitute for proof. External independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced geometry and ordinary matrix ranks are classified, not the potentially nonreduced scheme structure or centralizer-unit conjugacy classes.
Results apply to fixed Jordan type (n,1) with n at least 3; larger block partitions are not classified.
Priority relative to all possible general Hall-polynomial enumerations is not certified.
title: Parity geometry and rank census in hook nilpotent centralizers
